hunks.baseline: “I pay my respects to Great Hero Jin Taekyung, the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon!”
hunks.sol: “We pay our respects to Great Hero Jin Taekyung, the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon!”

hunks.baseline: At the moment that awe-filled cry rang throughout the grounds of the Sichuan Tang Clan, Jin Taekyung was not the only one who felt a shiver run through him.
hunks.sol: When that awe-filled cry rang throughout the grounds of the Sichuan Tang Clan, Jin Taekyung was not the only one who felt a shiver run through him.

hunks.baseline: The old master watching everything from a distance had to struggle to hide his swelling emotions.
hunks.sol: Watching from a distance, his old master had to struggle to contain the emotion welling up inside him.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang remembered the day he had first met Jin Taekyung as clearly as if it had happened yesterday.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang remembered the day he had first met Jin Taekyung as clearly as if it were yesterday.

hunks.baseline: The Third Young Master of a frontier martial family. The young man who had only just begun making a name for himself in Shanxi had become a Hidden Dragon, and at last, he had spread his wings wide and soared into the blue sky.
hunks.sol: The Third Young Master of a frontier martial family. The young man who had only just begun making a name for himself in Shanxi had become a Hidden Dragon, and now, at last, he was spreading his wings and soaring into the blue sky.

hunks.baseline: *Yes. You are the Divine Dragon, and the Great Hero.*
hunks.sol: *Yes. You truly are a Divine Dragon—and a Great Hero.*

hunks.baseline: Their eyes met, and Jeok saw Jin Taekyung grin. Leaning his upper body out the window, he waved both hands wildly.
hunks.sol: Their eyes met, and Jin Taekyung grinned. Leaning halfway out the window, he waved both hands wildly.

hunks.baseline: The solemn gathering flipped over all at once and became a cauldron of madness.
Jeok Cheongang burst into the laughter he had been holding back.
hunks.sol: The solemn gathering erupted into a frenzy, and Jeok Cheongang finally burst into the laughter he had been holding back.

hunks.baseline: His refreshing laughter mixed with the cheers. The breeze was cool, and the sky was clear.
hunks.sol: His hearty laughter mingled with the cheers. The breeze was cool, and the sky was clear.

hunks.baseline: It was the beginning of an age of turmoil, but the day a new hero was born was warm with spring.
hunks.sol: It was the dawn of an age of turmoil, but the day a new hero was born was warm with spring.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang appeared just after the cauldron of madness had settled down.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang appeared shortly after the frenzy died down.

hunks.baseline: “So many people crammed into a room as small as a grain of millet.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve packed quite a crowd into this millet-sized room.”

hunks.baseline: Unlike Cheongpung and Hyuk Mujin, who would have to die and come back to life before they learned to read the room, Gung Gibang was a pure-blooded beggar to the bone and moved immediately.
hunks.sol: Unlike Cheongpung and Hyuk Mujin, who could die and come back without ever learning to read the room, Gung Gibang was a pure-blooded beggar to his very bones. He moved at once.

hunks.baseline: “Oh my, now that you mention it, it does look cramped enough to burst. I’ll step outside.”
hunks.sol: “Oh my, now that you mention it, this place is practically bursting at the seams. I’ll wait outside.”

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung and Hyuk Mujin waved at him.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung and Hyuk Mujin waved him off.

hunks.baseline: “That fellow is finally leaving. Captain, haven’t you noticed the smell of a stray dog’s backside around here?”
hunks.sol: “He’s finally leaving. Captain, haven’t you smelled a stray dog’s ass around here for a while now?”

hunks.baseline: I carefully nodded.
hunks.sol: I nodded cautiously.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. It was a little strong…”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. It was pretty strong…”

hunks.baseline: “Stop talking crap and both of you get out!”
hunks.sol: “Stop talking shit and get out, both of you!”

hunks.baseline: “Fine, fine. Don’t get so angry, Young Hero Gung.”
hunks.sol: “All right. Don’t get so angry, Young Hero Gung.”

hunks.baseline: At Gung Gibang’s furious outburst, Cheongpung lowered his head with a dejected expression.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung lowered his head dejectedly at Gung Gibang’s furious outburst.

hunks.baseline: “Mimi. Say hello while doing a whirlwind.”
hunks.sol: “Mimi. Say goodbye with a whirlwind.”

hunks.baseline: Sssrrk. Sssrrrkk!
hunks.sol: Hiss. Hissss!

hunks.baseline: “…What the fuck.”
hunks.sol: “…What the fuck?”

hunks.baseline: Looks like Mimi had picked up some new tricks in the meantime. After putting on that flashy performance, Cheongpung was the last to leave the room.
hunks.sol: Looks like Mimi had picked up a new trick while I was out. After that flashy performance, Cheongpung was the last to leave the room.

hunks.baseline: “You reckless little brat. You certainly made quite a ruckus.”
hunks.sol: “You reckless little brat. You certainly made quite a spectacle of yourself.”

hunks.baseline: His face was stern, and his voice was low and calm.
hunks.sol: His face was stern, his voice low and subdued.

hunks.baseline: He really hadn’t changed at all. Seeing Jeok Cheongang act just like his usual self made me want to laugh for some reason.
hunks.sol: He hadn’t changed a bit. Seeing the same old Jeok Cheongang made me smile for some reason.

hunks.baseline: “Hah, look at this brat. You made a spectacle of yourself in front of everyone and dragged our sect’s reputation through the mud, yet you still have the nerve to say that?”
hunks.sol: “Hah, look at this brat. You disgraced yourself in front of everyone and dragged our sect’s reputation through the mud, yet you still have the nerve to say that?”

hunks.baseline: “You were laughing pretty loudly for someone who thought that.”
hunks.sol: “You were laughing awfully loudly for someone who thinks that.”

hunks.baseline: The stern expression he had been struggling to maintain collapsed all at once. Jeok Cheongang’s head slowly turned toward the window.
hunks.sol: The stern expression he had worked so hard to maintain collapsed. Jeok Cheongang slowly turned his head toward the window.

hunks.baseline: “About fifty people besides me probably saw it too. For a moment, I thought your smile had split your mouth open and you were bleeding from the corners.”
hunks.sol: “About fifty other people probably saw it too. I thought the corners of your mouth were going to split open and start bleeding.”

hunks.baseline: It was practically the Chinese Joker.
hunks.sol: He’d practically looked like the Chinese Joker.

hunks.baseline: My finishing shot left him no room to escape. Jeok Cheongang hesitated for a long while, unable to continue, before finally muttering one word.
hunks.sol: My finishing blow left him no avenue of escape. After a long hesitation, Jeok Cheongang finally muttered a single word.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang shouted with his face bright red, then grumbled under his breath.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang shouted, his face bright red, then grumbled under his breath.

hunks.baseline: The sight made the smile at my lips deepen.
hunks.sol: My smile deepened at the sight.

hunks.baseline: What was this? His expression seemed strangely off.
hunks.sol: What was this? His expression had suddenly turned strange.

hunks.baseline: His eyes even looked almost hurt. I asked, baffled,
hunks.sol: He almost looked hurt. Baffled, I asked,

hunks.baseline: “Your expression doesn’t really look like nothing…”
hunks.sol: “Your face doesn’t exactly say nothing…”

hunks.baseline: “Why are you shouting? The mood was finally warm and pleasant for once.”
hunks.sol: “Why are you shouting? Things were finally warm and pleasant for once.”

hunks.baseline: “If I say it’s nothing, then take it as nothing! You keep prying and asking questions, so this is happening!”
hunks.sol: “If I say it’s nothing, then take it as nothing! You’re the one who keeps prying!”

hunks.baseline: “Uh-oh. It’s getting worse?”
hunks.sol: “Whoa. It’s getting worse?”

hunks.baseline: What was wrong with this man all of a sudden? Had I made some kind of mistake?
hunks.sol: What was wrong with this man all of a sudden? Had I screwed something up?

hunks.baseline: It was just as I tilted my head in confusion.
hunks.sol: I was tilting my head in confusion when—

hunks.baseline: Ssssh.
hunks.sol: Rustle.

hunks.baseline: Their footsteps were so light and graceful that I might not have noticed them if my senses had not grown even keener after crossing the threshold.
hunks.sol: Their footsteps were so light and graceful that I might never have noticed them if my senses hadn’t grown even sharper after crossing the threshold.

hunks.baseline: After everything I had been through lately, my body moved on its own.
hunks.sol: After all the crises I had weathered lately, my body moved on its own.

hunks.baseline: But when I clenched my fists, Jeok Cheongang stopped me with a glance and waved his hand.
hunks.sol: But as I clenched my fists, Jeok Cheongang stopped me with a glance and waved one hand.

hunks.baseline: “You people are impatient. Couldn’t you wait fifteen minutes before coming swarming in?”
hunks.sol: “You’re all so impatient. Couldn’t even wait fifteen minutes before swarming up here?”

hunks.baseline: An old Buddhist nun and a Daoist answered Jeok Cheongang’s gruff voice in turn.
hunks.sol: An elderly Buddhist nun and a Daoist answered Jeok Cheongang’s gruff complaint in turn.

hunks.baseline: “Impatient? Hearing that from a lay devotee gives this poor nun a rather strange feeling.”
hunks.sol: “To hear you call someone else impatient feels rather strange.”

hunks.baseline: “This junior was discourteous. However, given the circumstances…”
hunks.sol: “This junior has been discourteous. However, given the circumstances…”

hunks.baseline: The old nun had a face covered in fine wrinkles, and I had never met her before. But I immediately recognized the Daoist.
hunks.sol: The elderly nun, her face covered in fine wrinkles, was a stranger to me. But I immediately recognized the Daoist.

hunks.baseline: The old Daoist was Cheongpung the Ancient Sword, the Sect Leader of the Qingcheng Sect whom I had once visited to ask for help in finding the Divine Physician.
hunks.sol: The old Daoist was Cheongpung the Ancient Sword, the Sect Leader of the Qingcheng Sect whom I had once visited to ask for help finding the Divine Physician.

hunks.baseline: *Then this nun must be the Sect Leader of Emei Sect… Who is she?*
hunks.sol: *Then this nun must be Emei Sect’s new Sect Leader… Who is she?*

hunks.baseline: I knew a fair amount about famous masters by now, but I wasn’t familiar enough with the internal affairs of every sect to know them in detail.
hunks.sol: I knew a fair amount about famous masters by now, but not enough to understand the inner workings of every sect.

hunks.baseline: Especially not a Sect Leader who had only recently taken office after the death of the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun.
hunks.sol: Especially when it came to a Sect Leader who had only recently taken office after the death of the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun.

hunks.baseline: As though he had read my thoughts, Jeok Cheongang sent me a quiet message through Sound Transmission.
hunks.sol: As if he had read my thoughts, Jeok Cheongang quietly sent me a Sound Transmission.

hunks.baseline: *That old hag is the Extinction Divine Nun of Emei Sect. She looks kind enough, but the moment she loses her temper, she’s a rakshasa incarnate. Watch what you say. And don’t even open your mouth about her age.*
hunks.sol: *That old hag is Emei Sect’s Extinction Divine Nun. She may look kindly, but once she loses her temper, she becomes a rakshasa incarnate. Watch your mouth around her. And whatever you do, don’t mention her age.*

hunks.baseline: I replied cautiously through Sound Transmission.
hunks.sol: I cautiously sent one back.

hunks.baseline: *Just how advanced in years is she?*
hunks.sol: *Just how old is she?*

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know Jeok Cheongang’s exact age, but I did know he was over a hundred years old. Add in the force suggested by her sobriquet…
hunks.sol: I didn’t know Jeok Cheongang’s exact age, but I knew he was over a hundred. Add the sheer force of that sobriquet…

hunks.baseline: I bowed deeply to the old woman who looked like the owner of a bossam restaurant.[^1]
hunks.sol: I bowed deeply to the ancient woman who looked like the matriarch of a bossam restaurant.[^1]

hunks.baseline: The Extinction Divine Nun studied me with a strange look in her eyes, then nodded.
hunks.sol: The Extinction Divine Nun studied me with an inscrutable look, then nodded.

hunks.baseline: “So the rumors were true. No—in fact, you’re even more than they said.”
hunks.sol: “So the rumors were true. No—they fell short.”

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung the Ancient Sword smiled faintly and continued,
hunks.sol: Cheongpung the Ancient Sword smiled faintly.

hunks.baseline: “The waves behind push the waves ahead on the Yangtze. It seems the younger generation intends to push even old people like us aside. To cross the threshold at such a young age…”
hunks.sol: “The waves behind drive the waves ahead on the Yangtze. It seems the younger generation means to sweep even old people like us aside. To cross the threshold at such a young age…”

hunks.baseline: “Ah, you mean the Sword Saint’s successor?”
hunks.sol: “Ah, the Sword Saint’s successor?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. This poor Daoist lacks the ability to judge which of the two is superior, but both young men are unquestionably heaven-sent. They are a great blessing to the Murim.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. This poor Daoist lacks the discernment to judge which of the two is superior, but both young men are unquestionably heaven-sent. They are a great blessing to the Murim.”

hunks.baseline: Interest and surprise flickered across the two faces marked by fatigue.
hunks.sol: Interest and surprise flickered across their weary faces.

hunks.baseline: Feeling awkward, I rolled my eyes around. That was when Jeok Cheongang stepped in front of me.
hunks.sol: I was shifting my eyes awkwardly when Jeok Cheongang stepped in front of me.

hunks.baseline: It didn’t make much difference, considering the enormous difference in our heights.
hunks.sol: Not that it accomplished much, considering the difference in our heights.

hunks.baseline: “You’re going to wear out the boy’s face. Say what you came to say and hurry up.”
hunks.sol: “You’ll wear the boy’s face out staring at him. Say what you came to say and hurry along.”

hunks.baseline: The two Sect Leaders looked embarrassed by his blunt words and finally got to the point.
hunks.sol: Chastened by his blunt words, the two Sect Leaders finally got to the point.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang asked in a displeased voice as he turned toward me.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang asked in a displeased voice, then turned to me.

hunks.baseline: Two Sect Leaders from the Nine Sects and One Gang were asking for my help. What exactly was I supposed to do?
hunks.sol: Two Sect Leaders from the Nine Sects and One Gang were asking for my help. What was I supposed to say?

hunks.baseline: I felt light enough on my feet, and accompanying them would let me hear what had happened so far. I had no particular reason to refuse.
hunks.sol: My body felt light, and accompanying them would give me a chance to hear everything that had happened. There was no real reason to refuse.

hunks.baseline: At my ready agreement, the two Sect Leaders took the lead and started walking.
hunks.sol: At my ready answer, the two Sect Leaders took the lead.

hunks.baseline: Then Jeok Cheongang suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: Then Jeok Cheongang abruptly asked,

hunks.baseline: “But why isn’t one of them here?”
hunks.sol: “But where’s the other one?”

hunks.baseline: “He said he didn’t want to attract the attention of the other people.”
hunks.sol: “He said he preferred not to attract anyone else’s attention.”

hunks.baseline: One of them? If he was important enough to be part of this group, was it Tang Sadok, the Family Head of the Tang Clan?
hunks.sol: The other one? If he was important enough to join this group, was it Tang Sadok, the Family Head of the Tang Clan?

hunks.baseline: But my curiosity vanished without a trace the moment we left the pavilion and ran into one person.
hunks.sol: But my curiosity vanished the moment we left the pavilion and encountered a familiar face.

hunks.baseline: The familiar face immediately drew a delighted shout from me.
hunks.sol: A delighted shout burst from me.

hunks.baseline: “Hey, you bastard! Mungyeong!”
hunks.sol: “Hey, you little punk! Mungyeong!”

hunks.baseline: Dark Heaven had invaded not long after he left, so I had been worried. Yet, perhaps our paths had simply missed each other, because he had somehow escaped without a scratch.
hunks.sol: Dark Heaven had attacked not long after his departure, so I’d been worried about him. But perhaps our paths had simply crossed, because he had somehow escaped without a scratch.

hunks.baseline: “When did you get here? You look taller than before. Are you going through a growth spurt?”
hunks.sol: “When did you get here? You look taller than before. Going through a growth spurt?”

hunks.baseline: “Why are you so quiet? Are you in a bad mood? Maybe…”
hunks.sol: “Why so quiet? Are you in a bad mood? Maybe…”

hunks.baseline: I ruffled Mungyeong’s hair, then leaned in and whispered,
hunks.sol: I ruffled Mungyeong’s hair, then leaned closer and whispered,

hunks.baseline: The little brat. Look at him saying nothing because he’s embarrassed.
hunks.sol: Look at the little brat. Too embarrassed to say a word.

hunks.baseline: It was something that happened from time to time at that age. This would be a good chance to spread some proper sex education through this dusty old Murim.
hunks.sol: That sort of thing happened from time to time at his age. Maybe this was my chance to spread proper sex education throughout this dusty old Murim.

hunks.baseline: “Your hyung here is going to show you a whole new world. From now on, call me Teacher Jin Seong-ae.”[^2]
hunks.sol: “Your hyung is going to show you a whole new world. From now on, call me Teacher Jin Seong-ae.”[^2]

hunks.baseline: Teacher Gu Seong-ae, are you watching? Your knowledge is crossing space and time to reach the next generation.
hunks.sol: Teacher Gu Seong-ae, are you watching? Your wisdom is crossing space and time to reach the next generation.

hunks.baseline: I was patting Mungyeong’s shoulder with a proud smile when—
hunks.sol: I was proudly patting Mungyeong on the shoulder when—

hunks.baseline: “Oh dear… We forgot to tell him that.”
hunks.sol: “Oh dear… We forgot to tell him.”

hunks.baseline: Three deep sighs came from behind me. At the same time, a flat voice emerged from between Mungyeong’s lips.
hunks.sol: Three long sighs sounded behind me. At the same time, Mungyeong spoke in a flat voice.

hunks.baseline: “And wet dreams ended a long time ago.”
hunks.sol: “And I stopped having wet dreams a long time ago.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s a little problematic, because your secondary sexual development hasn’t completely finished ye—no, that’s not what I mean.”
hunks.sol: “That’s a little concerning, because your secondary sexual development shouldn’t be complete y—wait. That’s not the point.”

hunks.baseline: A terrifying possibility had suddenly flashed through my mind.
hunks.sol: A terrifying possibility had just flashed through my mind.

hunks.baseline: “And that is how things came to this.”
hunks.sol: “…And that is how things came to this.”

hunks.baseline: Even while the two Sect Leaders used their movement techniques at tremendous speed, their voices did not waver.
hunks.sol: Even as the two Sect Leaders raced along using their movement techniques, their voices never wavered.

hunks.baseline: They looked to me for an answer, and I forced my lips apart.
hunks.sol: They looked at me, waiting for an answer. I forced my lips apart.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, right. So there’s some weird formation at the place we’re going?”
hunks.sol: “Ah, right. So there’s some kind of strange formation where we’re going?”

hunks.baseline: “According to the Third Fiend, whom we captured and interrogated, that appears to be the case. But the formation itself is so strange…”
hunks.sol: “That is what we learned after capturing and interrogating the Third Fiend. But the formation itself is so peculiar…”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang replied in a gruff voice.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang answered gruffly.

hunks.baseline: “This old man and this brat are both hopeless at formations. We wouldn’t understand anything even if we looked at it.”
hunks.sol: “This old man and this brat are both hopeless when it comes to formations. Looking at it won’t tell us a damned thing.”

hunks.baseline: I agreed. The Fire Gate Cavern on Mount Jiuhua had a formidable Mystic Gate Formation installed inside it, but that didn’t mean we were experts in formations.
hunks.sol: I agreed. The Fire Gate Cavern on Mount Jiuhua contained an extraordinary Mystic Gate Formation, but that didn’t make either of us experts.

hunks.baseline: *We should call in someone like the Zhuge Clan instead.*
hunks.sol: *We’d be better off calling someone from the Zhuge Clan.*

hunks.baseline: But it would take a considerable amount of time for the Zhuge Clan to arrive.
hunks.sol: But it would take the Zhuge Clan a considerable amount of time to get here.

hunks.baseline: “Fellow Daoist Jin, did you notice anything else strange about that man? Anything he said or did?”
hunks.sol: “Fellow Daoist Jin, did you notice anything else strange about that man? Anything in his words or behavior?”

hunks.baseline: “I’ve told you everything. And from what I could tell… I don’t think he could get any stranger than that.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve told you everything. And from what I could tell… I don’t think it was possible for him to get any stranger.”

hunks.baseline: Dark Heaven was strange by nature. They were fanatics who worshiped the Lord of Heaven as almost—no, simply—as a god.
hunks.sol: Dark Heaven was inherently strange. They were fanatics who worshiped the Lord of Heaven almost—no, exactly—like a god.

hunks.baseline: The powers and bizarre abilities shown by the Blood Lord and the Western Heaven Demon Lord were no different.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord and the Western Heaven Demon Lord were no different, with all their bizarre powers and abilities.

hunks.baseline: *Regenerating like a human Troll, taking an arm off and sticking it back on as if it had double-sided tape on it—and finally, even possession.*
hunks.sol: *One regenerated like a human Troll. Another popped his arm off and stuck it back on like he had double-sided tape under it. And then there was the possession at the end.*

hunks.baseline: The more I thought about it, the more miraculous it seemed.
hunks.sol: The more I thought about it, the more miraculous our victory seemed.

hunks.baseline: The fact that we had fought those people and won.
hunks.sol: We had fought those lunatics and somehow won.

hunks.baseline: “Before you woke up, we heard the general situation from Benefactor Jeok. Once the messenger eagle we sent to Henan returns with a reply, we should have a better idea of how to proceed.”
hunks.sol: “Before you awoke, Benefactor Jeok gave us a general account of what happened. Once the messenger eagle we sent to Henan returns with a reply, we should have a clearer idea of how to proceed.”

hunks.baseline: “If you notice anything strange when you inspect the formation, be sure to tell us.”
hunks.sol: “If you notice anything strange when you examine the formation, tell us.”

hunks.baseline: As I answered, I glanced toward the figure moving far ahead of us.
hunks.sol: As I answered, I glanced at the figure racing far ahead of us.

hunks.baseline: No—the man known by the sobriquet Slaughter Saint.
hunks.sol: No—the man known as the Slaughter Saint.

hunks.baseline: *Fuck. Why is the Slaughter Saint here?*
hunks.sol: *Fuck. What the hell is the Slaughter Saint doing here?*

hunks.baseline: To be honest, I almost pissed myself.
hunks.sol: Honestly, I had nearly pissed myself.

hunks.baseline: *Even if I spent half a day swimming in the Sanzu River valley, grilled meat, and came back, it wouldn’t be this bad.*[^3]
hunks.sol: Even if I’d spent half a day frolicking in the Sanzu River and stopped to grill some meat before coming back, I couldn’t have come any closer to death.[^3]

hunks.baseline: I was secretly letting out a sigh of relief when the dense undergrowth around us began to disappear, revealing towering cliffs ahead.
hunks.sol: I had just let out a private sigh of relief when the dense undergrowth around us fell away, revealing towering cliffs ahead.

hunks.baseline: [^1]: Bossam is boiled pork commonly wrapped in salted napa cabbage and served with condiments; a bossam restaurant owner is a familiar image of a hearty Korean neighborhood eatery.
hunks.sol: [^1]: Bossam is boiled pork commonly wrapped in salted napa cabbage and served with condiments; a bossam restaurant matriarch evokes the familiar image of an elderly Korean neighborhood restaurateur.

hunks.baseline: [^2]: Gu Seong-ae is a Korean sex educator. Taekyung is parodying her name by replacing Gu with Jin.
hunks.sol: [^2]: Gu Seong-ae is a Korean sex educator. Taekyung parodies her name by replacing Gu with Jin.

hunks.baseline: [^3]: In Buddhist tradition, the Sanzu River is associated with the boundary between life and death.
hunks.sol: [^3]: In Buddhist tradition, the Sanzu River marks the boundary between life and death.
